feature: Built-in pytest runner uses the project's Python
description: The built-in .py runner runs pytest through uv when a uv.lock is present, else through the project's virtualenv interpreter, else through python3. Nothing else about planning, judging or overrides changes.

specs.description: A uv project with uv.lock beside its pyproject.toml runs pytest through uv
specs.given: a repository whose sdk/ directory holds pyproject.toml and uv.lock, and a test sdk/tests/test_client.py defining test_connects; no test.runners.py is configured
specs.then: Planned::cmd runs `uv run python -m pytest` on the test file selected by `::test_connects` with `-q`, from sdk/

specs.description: A uv.lock above the pytest directory, but inside the repository, still selects uv
specs.given: a repository whose root holds uv.lock, and whose packages/sdk/ holds pyproject.toml and a test tests/test_a.py defining test_a
specs.then: Planned::cmd uses `uv run python -m pytest`, and pytest still runs from packages/sdk/, the directory holding pyproject.toml

specs.description: A uv.lock only in a directory below or beside the pytest directory does not select uv
specs.given: a repository whose root holds pyproject.toml and no uv.lock, whose other/ subdirectory holds uv.lock, and a test tests/test_a.py defining test_a; there is no .venv or venv
specs.then: Planned::cmd does not use uv. It is `python3 -m pytest …`, run from the repository root

specs.description: A uv.lock above the repository root is not looked at
specs.given: a repository root that has no uv.lock, no .venv and no venv, lying inside a parent directory that holds uv.lock; a test tests/test_a.py defines test_a
specs.when: plan_test is called with that root for tests/test_a.py::test_a
specs.then: Planned::cmd does not mention uv and uses python3

specs.description: uv is used exactly when a uv.lock exists at or above the pytest directory, within the repository
specs.given: any repository layout and any .py test whose function is in its file, with no test.runners.py configured
specs.then: Planned::cmd begins with `uv run python -m pytest` if and only if some directory from the pytest directory up to the repository root, inclusive, holds a uv.lock. The command runs from the same directory pytest would otherwise run from

specs.description: A project with .venv/bin/python runs pytest on that interpreter
specs.given: a repository whose root holds pyproject.toml and .venv/bin/python, has no uv.lock anywhere at or above it, and has a test tests/test_a.py defining test_a
specs.then: Planned::cmd invokes the .venv/bin/python interpreter with `-m pytest` on the test file selected by `::test_a` with `-q`, from the repository root, and does not invoke python3

specs.description: A venv/bin/python above the pytest directory selects that interpreter
specs.given: a repository whose root holds venv/bin/python, whose pkg/ holds pyproject.toml and a test tests/test_b.py defining test_b, and which has no uv.lock
specs.then: Planned::cmd invokes the root's venv/bin/python with `-m pytest`, run from pkg/

specs.given: a repository root holding pyproject.toml, uv.lock and .venv/bin/python, and a test tests/test_a.py defining test_a
specs.then: Planned::cmd uses `uv run python -m pytest`, not .venv/bin/python

specs.description: A .venv directory with no bin/python does not count, and neither does one below the pytest directory or above the repository root
specs.given: three repositories, each with pyproject.toml at its root and no uv.lock: one with a .venv/ that has no bin/python; one with tests/.venv/bin/python under its root; and one whose parent directory, outside the repository, holds .venv/bin/python
specs.when: plan_test is called in each for tests/test_a.py::test_a

specs.description: A virtualenv interpreter is used exactly when there is no uv.lock and a .venv/bin/python or venv/bin/python exists at or above the pytest directory, within the repository
specs.given: any repository layout and any .py test whose function is in its file, with no test.runners.py configured
specs.then: Planned::cmd runs `<dir>/bin/python -m pytest …`, for a .venv or venv directory found at or above the pytest directory, if and only if no uv.lock is found there and such an interpreter exists within the repository

specs.description: A project with neither uv nor a virtualenv runs python3 as before
specs.given: a repository with pyproject.toml at its root, no uv.lock, no .venv and no venv, and a test tests/test_a.py defining test_a
specs.then: Planned::cmd is `python3 -m pytest` on the test file selected by `::test_a` with `-q`, run from the repository root

specs.description: python3 is not used when the project has its own environment
specs.given: a repository with pyproject.toml and .venv/bin/python at its root, and a test tests/test_a.py defining test_a

specs.description: With no uv.lock and no virtualenv interpreter in reach, the command is the one ADR-2611211324 §8 built
specs.given: any repository layout with no uv.lock and no .venv/bin/python or venv/bin/python at or above the pytest directory within the repository, and any .py test whose function is in its file
specs.then: Planned::cmd is `python3 -m pytest <file>::<name> -q`, run from the nearest directory holding pyproject.toml, pytest.ini, tox.ini or setup.cfg, or from the repository root if there is none

specs.description: A configured test.runners.py still wins over the built-in runner in a uv project
specs.given: a repository with uv.lock and pyproject.toml at its root, a TestConfig whose runners map has a non-empty `py` template, and a test tests/test_a.py defining test_a
specs.then: Planned::cmd is the filled configured template and does not use `uv run python -m pytest`

specs.description: A missing uv fails the run with the command's own error, without falling back to python3
specs.given: a uv project whose sealed test tests/test_a.py::test_a would pass, run where `uv` is not on PATH
specs.when: the test is planned and run
specs.then: Planned::cmd is still the uv command, and the run is not a pass: it fails with the shell's command-not-found error for uv, and python3 is never invoked

specs.description: A missing test function is still refused before any command is planned, whatever the environment
specs.given: a uv project whose tests/test_a.py does not define test_missing
specs.then: plan_test returns Err and no Planned command is produced

specs.description: Judging is unchanged: two tests passing under uv is not a pass
specs.given: a uv project where the selected pytest run reports `2 passed`
specs.then: the verdict is not Passed, because exactly one passing test is still required

specs.description: Only the interpreter prefix depends on the environment; the directory, the selector, the judge and override precedence do not
specs.given: any repository layout and any .py test whose function is in its file, planned once as found and once with every uv.lock, .venv and venv removed
specs.then: both plans run from the same directory, with the same `<file>::<name> -q` arguments, and are judged by the same pytest judge. When a test.runners.py template is configured, both plans are that template
